description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at the top card of target player's library and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from the top of your library by paying 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
